nodes.text:
HMPV is a respiratory virus causing infections similar to RSV. 

Discovered in 2001, it spreads via respiratory secretions, peaking in late winter and early spring. 

Often, it presents with mild, cold-like symptoms. Stay informed! #HMPV #WellnessJourney #Cozyworks
